stages.reconstruct: For p+q=D, pq≤D²/4; pq=fD requires D≥4f. Equality only p=q. Thus 2f<D<4f impossible.

stages.repair: Require p,q>0, f>0, D≥4f and L<D.
stages.boundary_test: If an opaque mount restricts travel, can D>4f guarantee both positions are experimentally reachable?
